talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.bury.0: Somebody's left a piece of somebody. I'll see to it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.bury.1: Into the ground with you. You've lain about long enough.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.bury.2: Leave it lying and the dogs have it by noon.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.bury.3: Whoever you were, you'll rest better under the earth.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.bury.4: Another bit of a fight to tidy away. Hand me the spade.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.wash.1: Come here. You can't walk about town like that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.wash.2: That's not your blood, I hope. Stand there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.wash.3: You'll frighten the children. Let's get that off you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.wash.4: Mud to the knees again. Arms out.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.wash.5: A bucket and a minute. That's all I want from you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.scrub.0: Blood in the street. Not while I keep it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.scrub.1: The rain won't get to that before it dries.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.scrub.2: Out it comes, before the flies find it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.scrub.3: Somebody bled all the way along here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.scrub.4: Stand back. Water and straw, and it's gone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.scrub.5: That's the sort of thing that brings the dead calling.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.light.1: Lamp's lit. Rest easy, all of you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.light.2: Light by the graves, and nobody gets up tonight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.light.5: Dark's coming. Not here, it isn't.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.snuff.0: Morning. You can sleep in the sun now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.setup.0: This ground wants a lamp. I'll put one up.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.setup.1: A burying ground with no light is asking for trouble.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.setup.2: Graves and no lantern. That won't do.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.setup.3: There. Now the Warden can find them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.setup.4: Every grave wants watching. Let's start here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.setup.5: A post, a lamp, and they'll lie quiet.
trades.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.took_up.0: The burying ground wants keeping. I'll keep it.
trades.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.took_up.1: I'll see to the dead from now on, and what's left of the living.
trades.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.took_up.2: Somebody has to carry the spade. It may as well be me.
trades.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.moved_in.0: I heard this town had nobody to tend its graves.
trades.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.moved_in.1: A sexton, come to keep your lamp and your dead.
trades.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.moved_in.2: Show me where you bury your people.
